text:
vicky (PM): Quick huddle: we need final launch gates for Observe feature set (dashboards, tracing hooks with redaction, cost-by-model, error analytics). Keep it actionable.

andre (Eng): Risk: trace enrichment adds CPU + IO. Plan: bucketed sampling + error-first capture. Default policy: error=100%, success=bucketed tiers.

lee (SRE): On recent staging run we saw trace write throughput spike x6. Mitigation: bounded async buffer + backpressure. If queue > 4k auto-throttle sampling and alert.

sam (Eng-Platform): Proposed compact config for canary:
```yaml
observe:
  success_buckets: [5,1,0.1] # percents for low/med/high QPS
  error_capture: 100
  global_cap_per_region: 160
  redact_rules: [email, account_id]
```

zoe (Solutions): Customers want per-tenant opt-in for full traces and a CSV export for cost. FinCorp requires pre-approval and evidence of redaction.

vicky (PM): Acceptance gates for moving 10% -> 50%:
- Dashboard: error-by-model and cost tile present and updating <=3m
- Tracing: sampling honors policy; FinCorp redaction test passes (no email/account_id)
- Perf: p95 console latency increase < 12% vs baseline
- Ops: trace_queue_len < 4k and trace_write_p95 < 350ms
- Cost: rolling-2h cost delta <= 12%

andre (Eng): I'll add token-bucket limiter and metric `observe.limiter.dropped`.

lee (SRE): I'll run a 30m synthetic with error bursts and monitor auto-throttle. Fail if any gate breached.

sam (Eng-Platform): I'll expose /tenant/{id}/observe-status and the cost export endpoint.

canary-bot: canary deploy scheduled 09:00 PT -> 10% traffic.

vicky (PM): Everyone paste perf dashboards, canary logs, and redaction verification here during the window. If any gate fails, immediate rollback to previous flag. This thread is canonical for launch decisions. :white_check_mark:
